Spiti Valley, a high-altitude Himalayan desert in Himachal Pradesh, India, is famous for its stark, breathtaking landscapes, ancient Buddhist monasteries (like Key Monastery), pristine lakes (Chandratal), and unique Tibetan culture, offering a blend of adventure, serenity, and stunning views of rugged mountains and valleys, accessible via challenging but rewarding roads from Manali or Shimla
